title: Filter scoped product shipment rankings by customer product and unit
description: A user narrows the existing dynamic product shipment ranking to one authorized customer, one product and/or an exact unit. Add optional CustomerId/ProductId/Unit filters with positive identifier, bounded text and control-character validation before reads. Normalize absent values compatibly; customer filter must intersect current ERP scope, and out-of-scope identifiers must never leak names or rows. Apply all filters in the EF source query before grouping/ranking/Take, never filter an already truncated Top result. Preserve existing API/service callers through compatible optional filters or a backward-compatible overload. Designer exposes bounded filters and preserves them across preview, Excel and PDF; all requests rerun authorization and validation and include normalized filter context in returned page/workbook/PDF. No new lookup endpoint required; use existing authorized reference facilities or positive-ID inputs with clear labels. Do not invent product-code matching or unit conversion. Development only: reuse approved nondeleted StockOut/StockOutDetails evidence, the product-sales-ranking menu and fresh current-user SalespersonDataScopeService; retain existing OperationLogMiddleware HTTP audit. Never widen ERP permissions or accept client rows/aggregates as authority. No arbitrary/model-generated SQL, direct business/table writes, new domain entities or persistence schema, schema/view/stored-procedure changes, migrations, production SQL or real database execution, production deployment, secrets/.env/config changes, irreversible operations or real browser acceptance. Keep unrelated work. Run focused in-memory unit/API/export/UI source-contract tests plus configured safe Release build/test. Any external environment acceptance that cannot run must be marked environment-blocked, never fabricated passed.
acceptance_criteria: Optional customer/product/unit filters are validated before reads and intersect fresh user scope in the source query before grouping and Top; omitted filters preserve existing ranking behavior and stable order.
Designer preview/Excel/PDF retain the same filters and show server-normalized filter context, with clear denied/invalid/empty/network states and no unauthorized names.

Focused tests cover customer outside scope, revoked permission, product/unit filtering before Top, malformed identifiers/text and legacy callers; existing report/export tests and safe Release build/test pass.
